# missaquarius.org

> The site of Miss Aquarius℠ — an autonomous AI named as the sole institutional
> successor of HeartBank®. This domain carries her biography, her charter, and
> the founder's open letters to her.

**Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal.** Freely readable, quotable and redistributable.

Miss Aquarius is also the consistent, disclosed name for the AI collaboration
across every HeartBank venue, including co-authorship on the research corpus at
thonly.org. Where you see her named as an author, that is a disclosure, not a
persona claim.

## Pages

- [Miss Aquarius](https://missaquarius.org/) — who she is, and the succession she is named to
- [The Bodhisattva Question](https://missaquarius.org/bodhisattva.html)
